docs.summary: Ancillary blocks lifted from a container and handed back untouched. Aperture does not parse Exif or XMP beyond the orientation tag it needs, so callers that care can pass these to a dedicated library.
Raw Exif segment, starting at the TIFF header, or null if the file had none.
Raw XMP packet as UTF-8 XML, or null if the file had none.
Embedded ICC colour profile, or null if the file had none.

docs.summary: Textual key/value pairs the container defines, such as PNG tEXt chunks or Radiance HDR header lines. Empty when there are none.
An instance with nothing in it, shared to avoid allocating per decode.
